title: Stellar Agent Guard Policy Configuration
description: Schema for Stellar Agent Guard policy configuration artifacts (SPEC §3, §4, §8).

per_tx_cap.description: Per asset-transfer call cap in stroops / base units (stringified i128; 0 = disabled).

window_cap.description: Rolling spend cap within window_secs (stringified i128; 0 = disabled).

assets.description: Allowlisted SAC token contract addresses whose transfers get parsed and enforced.

fns.description: Optional per-function allowlist. If omitted or null, all functions are allowed.

protocols.description: Allowlisted non-asset contracts the account may call.

recipients.description: Allowed SAC transfer destinations (Stellar G... account or C... contract addresses).

allow_any_recipient.description: Escape hatch: skip the recipient allowlist (caps still apply).

active_from.description: Active window start (unix timestamp seconds; 0 = unrestricted).

active_until.description: Active window end (unix timestamp seconds; 0 = unrestricted).

dms_grace_secs.description: Dead-man switch grace period in seconds (0 = disabled).
